subject: Scheduling: hands-on benchmarking session & POC lab (prompt review + load run)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: POC bench session — initial dates and goals

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the quick sync today. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock a hands-on benchmarking session during the POC where we will:
- walk through your prompt set and routing rules,
- run a focused load test (throughput targets + 95th pct latency SLOs), and
- validate integration/access (sample dataset + allowlist).

Suggested outcomes: a runbook with observed perf, tuning notes (prompt-level routing/kv cache highlights), and a recommended config for Redwood Dedicated.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, 8 Dec — 9:00–13:00 (deep dive + light load run)
- Thu, 10 Dec — 10:00–14:00 (full-load run + wrap)

I've attached a one-page proposed agenda and a shared folder with the test-plan template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPROPOSED-AGENDA

Can you confirm which window works for your team and who from BlueWave will need console access? Also flag any network/firewall constraints up front so our infra team can pre-configure.

Thanks — we'll bring the test harness and a short checklist for the load run.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachments: proposed-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: engops@bluewave.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC bench session — initial dates and goals

Hi Marissa —

Both windows look promising. We are definitely interested in splitting the session into a prompt/review block and a separate full-load run. A couple of notes from our side:
- Throughput target for the POC: 5,000 requests/min (steady-state), with short bursts to 7,500/min.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 150ms for the critical prompt path.
- We'll bring a sample dataset and a test user pool; EngOps will need an allowlist for your test agents.

Attendees likely: myself, Priya Rao (Product), and Jun Park (EngOps). We prefer Thu, 10 Dec if that's still available.

Can you confirm duration for the full-load run and whether you require a dedicated GPU pool for the run vs. a shared sandbox? Also please send lab access instructions and any firewall allowlist format.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Product, BlueWave Analytics
sarah@bluewave.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC bench session — initial dates and goals

Hi Sarah —

Thu, 10 Dec sounds good — locking that provisional. Proposed agenda/timing (PT):
- 10:00–11:15 — Prompt review + routing rules (Marissa + Priya)
- 11:15–12:00 — Integration check & lab access validation (Connor + Jun)
- 12:00–13:30 — Full-load run (Dylan will own the harness, Marissa will monitor SLOs)
- 13:30–14:00 — Results, immediate tuning, next steps

For the full-load run we typically budget 90 minutes: 15 min warmup, 60 min steady-state, 15 min cooldown. If you plan on longer steady-state, let us know — we can extend and adjust infra. We recommend a dedicated GPU pool for deterministic results; we can provision a small dedicated queue for the window and tear it down afterwards.

I've attached lab-access-instructions.txt with the ports and agent IP ranges we need; Connor will follow up on any IP allowlisting.

On our side: Dylan will bring the load harness (JMeter + k6 wrapper), Connor will handle environment setup, and I'll run the prompt/routing review.

Please reply with final attendee emails and whether you want the dedicated pool.

—Marissa
